author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: smooth open silhouette with two big rounded upright ears, a flat crown, cheek notches and a neck flaring to the bottom; matches the corgi reference. The rejected drawing was built from straight angular lines. First candidate ears were too small; enlarged and the neck flared.
drawing_plan: SQUARE symmetric about x 24: neck beziers from (7,42) to notches (12,24); ear outer edges out to (6,12) and over tips (11,6); inner edges to the crown (19,15)-(29,15).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'cat'/'dog' head outline with upright ears.
